allocator_preference.reason: Eliminates observed pending-source reuse; retain safe waiting under pressure. Throughput effects are small and change sign in the controlled retest.

native_full_store_submission.reason: Removes main-worker CUDA submission, reduces exposed pre-forward work and gaps, and improves the four-repeat mean serving rate. Full versus chunked throughput is not distinguished statistically.

private_tensor_physical_merging.reason: Descriptors merge successfully, but one repeat loses 12.9% throughput with large load-only gaps.

recycled_cpu_order.reason: Both repeats remain slower than block-major.

independent_load_readiness.reason: All loads use the intended guarded path, but both matched repeats regress; mean -4.85%.

specific_producer_events.reason: Did not establish reliable serving benefit; first repeat has a large regression.

gpu_block_ascending.reason: No live merging under block-major CPU storage and highly variable performance.

preserved_descriptor_order.reason: Actual-layout probe loses the sorted-order bandwidth benefit without reducing descriptors. Full serving run deliberately omitted.

setup_lead_25_ms.reason: Recovery 95.28% to 98.65% and rounds 41.5 to 40.5, but mean paired throughput -0.49% and gaps 255.4 to 292.7 ms. Keep 100 ms in selected configuration.

definitions: Selection uses demonstrated mechanism, safety checks and matched serving results. Do not rank proposals by absolute rates from different cohorts or arrival harnesses; do not interpret small repeat counts as statistical confidence.
